mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 0.2% signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases > 0.1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a late-cycle expansion, which leads to a shift in monetary policy toward tightening and profit-taking in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth rate > 2% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases > 0.5% and RSAFS increases > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
